name: call-of-cthulhu-plugin
description: Create, edit and roll guest Call of Cthulhu investigator sheets. Keep drafts locally and import/export JSON.

interface.longDescription: An editable Call of Cthulhu 7th edition investigator sheet with characteristics, skills, health, sanity, luck, weapons, backstory and possessions. No account required. Drafts stay in your browser where the host permits; export JSON for a portable backup. Dice history lasts for the current view only. Explicitly attach a draft to share it with ChatGPT. Cloud saving and Quest Portal accounts are planned for a later release.
defaultPrompt: Open my Call of Cthulhu investigator sheets.
Help me create a Call of Cthulhu investigator.
